newsitem.title: USA: Regions to buy Georgiabank for $17m-Regions.
newsitem.headline: Regions to buy Georgiabank for $17m-Regions.

text.p: Regions Financial Corp said on Wednesday it signed a definitive agreement to buy GF Bancshares Inc for about $17 million.
The company said it expected to close the deal in the fourth quarter of this year.
GF Bancshares stockholders will receive that fraction of a share of Regions common stock obtained by dividing $18 by the Regions share price during a specified period, the company said.
Based on Regions closing stock price of 61-1/4 on June 10, the transaction is valued at about $17 million.
The company said the transaction, which it expects to be tax free, is subject to GF shareholders' and regulatory approval.

GF Bancshares had total assets of $97 million, deposits of $78 million and stockholders' equity of $12.5 million as of March 31 fiscal 1997. It reported a net income of $276,000 for the first quarter.
Regions may purchase up to about 316,000 shares of its common stock in the open market in connection with this transaction, which is expected to be accounted for as a purchase, the company said.
